scope: Nested food-energy-other CES is the default in stages 4 and 5; the four nest elasticities are common across Q1-Q5. An explicit flat specification uses household_sigma (2 by default) only for comparison.
interpretation: Literature-informed calibration adaptation, not a Turkish estimate. Upper 0.25, food 0.5, energy 0.4, other 0.5; EMPAX Table 3-4 and SAGE Table 9. Food mapping and three-way upper nest are study-specific adaptations.
production_and_trade_elasticities: Unchanged from the CD reference model.
